author_boundary: Independent reviewer, not inventory/parser author. Wrote only this exclusive report and distinct private-prefix checks. No production/frozen/capture changes.

findings.fact: Extraction accepts exact immutable ADT bytes and explicit schema profile. Fixed parser path/source SHA is bounded-read and the exact checked bytes are compiled, with no exec_module reread. Existing bounded parser rejects duplicate properties/node paths, truncation/trailing bytes and tree limits. Inserted facts are refused rather than silently removed/canonicalized. Profile/digests label supplied source; they do not independently prove board identity or authenticity.

Required unique /defaults/pmap-io-ranges is framed24B<QQII>, with raw row, address/size,wimg and signature preserved. Source layout has an explicit24-byte static assertion and direct property-array use. Present empty is retained OBSERVED_EMPTY; missing/ambiguous/partial refuses. No source rows are filtered by flags or transformed into a native pmap validity assertion; byte extents remain unrounded.

All-tree segment-ranges/names pairs use exact32B<QQQII>:phys,opaqueIOVA,remap,size,opaqueu32. Unknown/dangling metadata, unsupported name bytes/cardinality and ambiguous tree identity refuse. Identical row payloads/repeated display labels remain distinct by path+slot; global ordinal follows sorted path order and original slot order. No label trim/casefold/dedup occurs.

IOVA remains rawu64, includingzero/MAXu64/wrap-looking combinations, with no PA check, translation or size arithmetic. All remap observations are retained, includingzero as ZERO_NUMERICAL_VALUE_NOT_ABSENCE; nonzero values remain source-only. Physical/remap numeric extents require nonzero size and completePA36 bounds, while basezero is allowed. None of these facts establishes a mapping or exclusion.

DRAM is exact8+8 /chosen data. VRAM is fixed /vram device_type=vramNUL and exactly oneQQreg under explicit rootcells2/2 and absence of root ranges/dma-ranges. Full declared span is retained without visible framebuffer/MCC/retention inference. Raw selected payload and serialized property header/padding are preserved with fresh digests; named addresses alone confer no reservation/backing authority.

Projected capacity counts pmap+physical+ALLremap+VRAM1 and refuses above256 before truncation. It is independent of any future8-range union cap. No interval union, bpl_policy/NPS conversion, native owner configure, ADT writer, registry or hardware access exists in extraction. Metadata explicitly marks source completeness/policy authority false.

byte_verification.scope: Local read-only Git object/source checks only, no source fetch. Settled downstream decoder behavior not re-reviewed.

independent_cases.detail: 109 identical pmap rows plus37 identical segment rows with repeated space-preserving labels across two paths; allzero remaps andMAXu64IOVAs retained. Tree reorder preserves row identities but changes whole-input digest. Exact256 accepts257 refuses without dedup. DRAMzero-base/fullPA36end and invalidextent controls are metadata-only.

historical_source_replay.note: 184 includes the explicit VRAM observation added before freeze; no183-record truncation or dedup. Replaying saved ADT is an inventory test, not a new hardware observation/nativefacts handoff or old-grade change. No raw source addresses/names/rows printed.

limitations: Caller-supplied source identity/authenticity, freshness/quiescence and every required global source class remain unproven. A schema profile is not hardware identity.
Root translation guards support the declared fixed source schema only, not general buses or arbitrary address-map conventions.
Raw numeric source spans, zero remaps, named VRAM and IOVA observations do not authorize physical access, usable RAM, DMA eligibility, actual Darwin retention or policy conversion.
The fixed existing parser module verifies/loads its bound Python dependencies; extraction is host filesystem verification, not a zero-I/O claim. No hardware-capable adapter is invoked.
No registry publisher, native facts handoff, complete exclusion union, owner/configuration, packet/deployment or runtime boot is admitted.
